verdict.rationale: Airbyte lets users control where data is processed and stored by self-hosting. The docs say you can run it anywhere Docker runs (abctl), deploy it into any Kubernetes cluster, or run a local open-source instance, and a community user confirms self-hosting in production. Residency control comes only through running your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: any documented region or data-residency selection for Airbyte Cloud, explicit residency or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
